en.headline: Observatory forecasts mainly fine and dry weather for the work week after Chung Yeung
en.dek: With Monday a public holiday, the coming work stretch from Tuesday is expected to be mainly fine and dry, turning very hot midweek under an anticyclone aloft.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the weather would remain mainly fine and dry in the coming days after the Chung Yeung Festival long weekend, with temperatures rising to very hot levels on Wednesday.

According to the latest nine-day forecast issued on Sunday morning, Tuesday is expected to be fine and dry with highs around 32 degrees under light easterly winds. Wednesday could see the temperature climb to 33 degrees or above as a strong anticyclone aloft brings dry and very hot conditions, with isolated light rain patches possible at night.

The northeast monsoon is expected to bring mainly cloudy weather with one or two rain patches early on Thursday before turning fine and dry again later in the week. The Observatory continued to note that the yellow fire danger warning remains in force and the fire risk is high amid the dry conditions.
Monday 19 October is a general holiday in substitution for Chung Yeung Festival, which falls on Sunday this year. The outlook covers the subsequent work stretch through the rest of the week.

zh.headline: 天文台料重陽假期後下周工作天大致天晴乾燥 星期三或醒熱
zh.dek: 星期一為公眾假期，天文台預測星期二起工作周大致天晴乾燥，星期三受高空反氣旋影響日間醒熱。
body: 香港天文台表示，重陽節長周末後未來數日大致天晴乾燥，星期三日間氣溫會升至醒熱水平。
根據星期日早上發出的九天天氣預報，星期二天晴乾燥，最高氣溫約32度，吹和緩東風。星期三受高空反氣旋影響，最高氣溫或達33度或以上，晚上或有一兩陣微雨。
東北季風預料星期四初期帶來大致多雲及一兩陣雨，其後再轉天晴乾燥。天文台繼續提醒，黃色火災危險警告仍生效，乾燥天氣下火災危險性顇高。
今年重陽節正日為星期日，星期一（10月19日）為代替假期。今次展望覆蓋假期後的工作周。
